rule.description: Z-Push messages grouped
Z-Push informational message
Z-Push warning: $(zpush.message)
Z-Push error: $(zpush.message)
Z-Push fatal error for $(dstuser): $(zpush.message)
Z-Push debug message
Z-Push request completed: $(zpush.cmd) by $(dstuser) from $(srcip)
Z-Push request without credentials from $(srcip)
Z-Push: built-in administrator account $(dstuser) used through ActiveSync from $(srcip) (device '$(zpush.devid)')
Z-Push: built-in administrator account $(dstuser) used through ActiveSync from public address $(srcip) (device '$(zpush.devid)')
Z-Push: first request of $(dstuser) with device '$(zpush.devid)' ($(zpush.devtype)) seen by this manager, from $(srcip)
Z-Push: first request of $(dstuser) with device '$(zpush.devid)' ($(zpush.devtype)) seen by this manager, from public address $(srcip)
Z-Push: first request of $(dstuser) without a phone or tablet (method $(protocol), command '$(zpush.cmd)') seen by this manager, from $(srcip)
Z-Push: first request of $(dstuser) without a phone or tablet (method $(protocol), command '$(zpush.cmd)') seen by this manager, from public address $(srcip)
Z-Push: ActiveSync login rejected for $(dstuser) from $(srcip) (device $(zpush.devtype) $(zpush.devid))

rule.match: \] (?:ZPushAutodiscover-\x3egetLogin\(\): Login failed for user '|Unable to complete autodiscover because login failed for user with email ')
rule.description: Z-Push: autodiscover login rejected for $(dstuser) from $(srcip)
Z-Push: ActiveSync login rejected for $(dstuser) from $(srcip) (LOGAUTHFAIL line, counted by its request summary)
Z-Push: request of $(dstuser) rejected: $(zpush.message)

rule.field: ^Zimbra-\x3eSoapRequest\(\): (?:zimbra Auth Token has expired|zimbra 2FA Auth Failed|zimbra ActiveSync Disabled for user|Z-Push Server IP Address not listed in zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs) - Throw AuthenticationRequiredException
rule.description: Z-Push: the mail server refused $(dstuser) for a reason other than the password: $(zpush.message)
Z-Push: ActiveSync is disabled for $(dstuser) on the mail server, the device is refused

rule.field: ^Zimbra-\x3eSoapRequest\(\): Z-Push Server IP Address not listed in zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs
rule.description: [WARN] Z-Push: Zimbra refuses the Z-Push server (not in zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs), every login fails
Z-Push: Zimbra DoSFilter is throttling the Z-Push server (add it to zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs)

rule.field: ^Zimbra-\x3e(?:SoapRequest\(\): (?:ERROR: curl_exec - |SOAP FAULT: HTML Error Returned - |Connection Refused - )|Logon\(\): END Logon - Proxy Error)
rule.description: Z-Push: request to the mail server failed: $(zpush.message)
Z-Push: the mail server refused the two-factor login of $(dstuser) (an ActiveSync device needs an application code as its password)

rule.field: ^Zimbra-\x3eSoapRequest\(\): (?:Auth Token Expired|2FA Auth Failed|ActiveSync Disabled for user|Z-Push Server IP Address not listed in zimbraHttpThrottleSafeIPs) - Force client to reconnect\.
rule.description: Z-Push: request of $(dstuser) refused by the mail server for a reason other than the password: $(zpush.message)

rule.field: ^(?:Not enough privileges of '.*' to setup for user '.*': Permission denied|User '.*' has no admin privileges)$
rule.description: Z-Push: $(dstuser) tried to manage another account's mobile devices through the Z-Push webservice without the rights to: $(zpush.message)
Z-Push: ActiveSync request of $(dstuser) from $(srcip) refused by the mail server for a reason other than the password (not counted as a failed login)
Z-Push: autodiscover login of $(dstuser) from $(srcip) refused by the mail server for a reason other than the password (not counted as a failed login)
[WARN] Z-Push: repeated rejected ActiveSync logins for $(dstuser), last from $(srcip) (brute force, or a device with a stale password)
[WARN] Z-Push: rejected ActiveSync logins for several accounts from $(srcip) (password spraying), last $(dstuser)
[WARN] Z-Push: rejected ActiveSync logins for several accounts from listed address $(srcip) (password spraying, or a proxy that hides the client address), last $(dstuser)
[WARN] Z-Push: rejected ActiveSync logins for many accounts from many addresses within ten minutes (distributed password spraying), last $(dstuser) from $(srcip)
[WARN] Z-Push: repeated rejected autodiscover logins for $(dstuser), last from $(srcip)
[WARN] Z-Push: rejected autodiscover logins for several accounts from $(srcip) (password spraying), last $(dstuser)
[WARN] Z-Push: rejected autodiscover logins for several accounts from listed address $(srcip) (password spraying, or a proxy that hides the client address), last $(dstuser)
[WARN] Z-Push: $(dstuser) logged in from $(srcip) after repeated rejected logins (password guessed, or a stale password corrected)
[HIGH] Z-Push: login of $(dstuser) succeeded from $(srcip), which was spraying passwords

[HIGH] Z-Push: $(dstuser) logged in from public address $(srcip) with a device this manager had never seen ('$(zpush.devid)', $(zpush.devtype)), after three or more rejected logins for the account within 15 minutes
[HIGH] Z-Push: $(dstuser) logged in from public address $(srcip) after repeated rejected logins, with a device this manager had never seen ('$(zpush.devid)', $(zpush.devtype))

[HIGH] Z-Push: $(dstuser) used three devices this manager had never seen within 15 minutes, the last '$(zpush.devid)' ($(zpush.devtype)) from public address $(srcip): several clients have the password

[WARN] Z-Push: $(dstuser) used three devices this manager had never seen within 15 minutes, the last '$(zpush.devid)' ($(zpush.devtype)) from private address $(srcip): several clients have the password
Z-Push: request of $(dstuser) failed, mail server unavailable: $(zpush.message)
Z-Push: the mail server is unavailable, repeated failed requests (503)
[WARN] Z-Push: the mail server has been unavailable for most of an hour
Z-Push: new device $(zpush.devid) registered for $(dstuser)
Z-Push: device of $(dstuser) with a pending remote wipe connected
Z-Push: remote wipe sent to device $(zpush.devid) of $(dstuser), requested by $(zpush.wipe_by)
[WARN] Z-Push: device $(zpush.devid) of $(dstuser) confirmed the remote wipe requested by $(zpush.wipe_by)

rule.match: \] User '[^']*' has requested a remote wipe for this device
rule.description: Z-Push: remote wipe of a shared device requested by $(zpush.wipe_by) applies to $(dstuser)
Z-Push: the device policy changed, devices are provisioned again

rule.field: ^WebserviceDevice::RemoveDevice\('.*'\): remove device state data of user '
rule.description: Z-Push: a mobile device partnership was removed through the Z-Push webservice by $(dstuser): $(zpush.message)

rule.field: ^WebserviceDevice::WipeDevice\('.*'\): mark device of user '.*' for remote wipe$
rule.description: Z-Push: a remote wipe of a mobile device was requested through the Z-Push webservice by $(dstuser): $(zpush.message)
Z-Push: $(dstuser) is managing the mobile devices of another account through the Z-Push webservice: $(zpush.message)
Z-Push: synchronisation loop detected for $(dstuser)
Z-Push: synchronisation loop detected for $(dstuser): $(zpush.message)
Z-Push: a previous request of $(dstuser) terminated unexpectedly (PHP crash or timeout)
Z-Push: routine provisioning request or WBXML dump
Z-Push: repeated fatal errors on this host

Z-Push: request of $(dstuser) from a scripting or attack tool (user agent '$(zpush.useragent)')

Z-Push: a device of $(dstuser) is fetching $(zpush.changes) items of folder $(zpush.folder)
